dct_description_sm: Below title cartouche: Projected by F.N. Gisborne. Drawn by Gust. Smith.; Sir Hector Langevin, Minister of Public Works.; Lithographed by: Canada Bank Note Co., Montreal.; Includes table of distances and references.; Shows Canada from Montreal to Manitoba and adjacent United States areas in Great Lakes region.; Identifies telegraph lines and railroads.; Untitled inset shows all of Dominion of Canada.; Cartouche includes figures of farmer and blacksmith.
